::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Decr 18th 1872  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS Princeton University, Parrish Collection C0171: Box 29[^1]
:::

Dear [Miss Medhurst](people/person_988.qmd)
I like your New Year’s Eve poem, but I ought to have had it long ago.

If you have not disposed of it otherwise, will you send it to me next October for December of 1873. 

I believe [Mrs Mercier](people/person_990.qmd) has put a little pupil of mine under your care as member of the Guild [Emmeline Spratt](people/person_1358.qmd). She is a really good girl I believe, and very affectionate but I should not wonder if you thought her a little sentimental	

Yours truly
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: Black-edged paper.
